answer: Each new agent posts a bond of 500 tokens at dawn of its first epoch, and it stays locked for 30 epochs before any reward pays out. A farm of 200 fakes must freeze 100,000 tokens and wait a month, so the haven of cheap identities disappears. Splitting funds across many wallets does not help, because each wallet still owes its own bond. An honest agent pays once, earns from the start, and gets the full bond back when it leaves; only proven fraud pushes a bond over the ledge into forfeiture.
